title: Preemption by federal law.
bodyText: This chapter shall not be applied in a manner that would render its application preempted by the "Petroleum Marketing Practices Act", 15 U.S.C. [section] 2801, et seq., or other applicable federal law.
bodyHtml: [§486H-12]  Preemption by federal law.  This chapter shall not be applied in a manner that would render its application preempted by the "Petroleum Marketing Practices Act", 15 U.S.C. [section] 2801, et seq., or other applicable federal law. [L 1993, c 329, pt of §1]
